text: Your books show a profit. Your bank balance tells a different story. And by the time the monthly MIS is ready, it is often too late to act.
Meet OfficeMitra, your AI CFO dashboard, from SanMitra Tech Solutions.
Connect the books you already keep: Tally, Zoho Books, Busy, or a journal export from any ERP. OfficeMitra only reads your data. It never changes a voucher, and it runs on your own computer.
The CEO pack shows how the business is really doing: sales growth, margins, cash position and working capital, with plain notes on what needs attention.
The CFO pack goes deeper, with debtor days, inventory, the GST position, and a thirty, sixty and ninety day cash forecast, built from your open receivables and payables.
See exactly where your cash is stuck: how long customers have owed you, who owes the most, and which suppliers you depend on.
For the board, OfficeMitra raises red flags automatically, such as debtor days above your policy or a negative cash position, and exports a meeting-ready pack as PDF or Excel.
When a number moves, OfficeMitra explains why, straight from the posted books. And with a local AI model, you can ask questions about your books in plain English.
For CA practices, every client's books sit on one screen, so you can see who needs attention first.
OfficeMitra, by SanMitra Tech Solutions. Clear numbers. Early warnings. Better decisions. Visit sanmitratech dot in.
